questions.q: Revenue is $400,000 and gross profit is $100,000. What is the gross profit margin?
Current assets $60,000 (including inventories $20,000); current liabilities $40,000. What is the acid test ratio?
questions.why: Acid test = (60,000 − 20,000) ÷ 40,000 = 1.0; 1.5 is the current ratio.

questions.q: Which statement shows a business's assets and liabilities at one point in time?
questions.why: The income statement covers a period; the statement of financial position is a snapshot.

questions.model: The profit left after tax and dividends have been paid, which is kept in the business.
